name: Have you completed a business impact assessment to determine the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data if the service was compromised?
conditionsText:
This applies when:
- A new service is being developed.
- Existing services are changing significantly.
- Information assets have been identified.
- Security risks are being assessed.
The guidance recommends completing this during discovery or requirements gathering and updating it whenever significant assets change
requirementTitle: Have you completed a business impact assessment to determine the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data if the service was compromised?
requirementDescription:
Have you assessed what would happen to the organisation, users and service if its data or systems were:
- Read by unauthorised people (Confidentiality)
- Changed or corrupted (Integrity)
- Unavailable (Availability)
why:
Not all information and systems are equally important.
The organisation needs to understand which assets would cause the greatest damage if compromised so it can:
- Prioritise security investment.
- Identify the most important risks.
- Design appropriate security controls.
- Support threat modelling and risk assessments.
tasks: Have you completed a business impact assessment to determine the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data if the service was comp

actions.title: Have you completed a business impact assessment to determine the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data if the service was comp
actions.description:
The assessment should consider, confidentiality, integrity and availability. The assessment should document:
• Assets being assessed.
• Impact ratings.
• Consequences of compromise.
• Overall business impact.
